headline: Pass 2: main deploys can no longer be cancelled by a PR push. The signals kit is vendored, with the bundle guard on the uploaded dist. The 837 static question pages now send page_view (checked live: a real browser inserts one row, webdriver sends nothing). The best exam score no longer compares old 60-question attempts with 30-question ones.

shipped.title: ci: never cancel a main deploy; vendor the signals contract kit
shipped.live_checked: Main run 70 succeeded, with the analytics guard passing on the uploaded dist. The live bundle carries the Supabase project URL and the isAutomatedBrowser pattern (googleother).

shipped.title: feat(analytics): page_view beacon on the 837 static question pages
shipped.live_checked: /fw-beacon.js is served, and /otazka/313/ loads it. Real Chromium (webdriver off, normal UA) sent POST /rest/v1/events and got 201, and the row is in flywheel-core events: page_view {path:/otazka/313/, static:true}. Default Playwright (webdriver on) sent no request.

shipped.title: fix(stats): rank exam attempts by ratio; mark the old 60-question format
shipped.live_checked: Main run 76 deployed it. On the live site in real Chromium, with seeded attempts [26/30 new, 50/60 old], the tile shows 26 / 30 with no old-format mark. With [25/30, 58/60] it shows 58 / 60 plus starý test (60 otázek).

signals_fixed: Static question pages (837 URLs, the SEO surface) sent no events. They now send page_view {path, static:true} with the shared fw:vid visitor id.
Crawlers and headless browsers that run JS (Googlebot etc.) were counted as visitors by the app. flywheel-client now drops them, along with webdriver.
Analytics bundle guard (flywheel:analytics-guard) runs on the exact dist that is uploaded, so a build without VITE_SUPABASE_* fails the deploy instead of shipping silent.
A PR push could cancel an in-flight main deploy. Concurrency now cancels only off main.
Kit file names (flywheel-events.contract.test.ts, flywheel-events.json, check-analytics.mjs) now exist for the fleet check.

decisions.question: Two allow-lists after vendoring the kit: which governs track()?
decisions.default_taken: Kept both. The typed mirror stays what track() accepts, and a test fails if it has a name missing from the kit list or still pending there.
decisions.why: The kit's events array includes pending names the live policy drops (read back from pg_policies today), so on its own it would pass a start_weak_drill-style loss. The typed mirror is stricter.

decisions.question: Where to run the analytics guard, given the upload step sits in the test job that also runs on PRs
decisions.why: This keeps it on the exact dist that ships, as specified. The cost is that a fork PR (no secrets) would fail the guard, but this repo has no fork contributors.

decisions.question: How the static beacon sends
decisions.default_taken: fetch with keepalive, apikey header only, Prefer: return=minimal; ~1 KB file /fw-beacon.js written at prerender with the build env
decisions.why: sendBeacon can't set the apikey header, and supabase-js would be the app bundle weight the pages avoid. Publishable keys need no Authorization header. Without the env, no beacon is written (local builds).

decisions.question: Beacon scope
decisions.why: Okruh pages boot the app, which already sends app_open, so beaconing them too would double count.

decisions.question: Old 60-question exam attempts in the best-score tile
options: rank by ratio across both and label old
decisions.default_taken: Rank by share correct (tie goes to the newer attempt), show score / total, and add 'starý test (60 otázek)' when the best is an old attempt
decisions.why: Keeps people's history and makes the format visible. Stored data is untouched.

decisions.question: Verification row in production events
decisions.default_taken: Left one page_view row (visitor_id d188952a-9989-440e-988c-83ad5458ed5f, 2026-10-28 10:16:36 UTC) from the live check
decisions.why: Deleting rows from the shared table is a data deletion that waits for Pavol. Filter it out by visitor_id if it matters.
